dismissals: Both remaining "Learn more" controls are outbound links that leave the app being mapped: the one on example.com goes to https://www.iana.org/domains/example, and the ones on the Acrobat tab go to Adobe help/marketing pages. Instructions say to stay on example.com rather than following off-site links, and neither reveals any in-app surface.

These belong to the acrobat.adobe.com "What's new" tab, not to example.com (the app under exploration). Each either navigates off-site to Adobe marketing/commerce pages ("View details", "View plans and pricing", "Try it now"), launches the Chrome extension outside the page ("Open Acrobat extension"), or changes account/notification state ("Start free trial", "Change your preferences") — externally visible or unrevertable actions I must not take.

nodes.title: Example Domain (example.com home)
nodes.notes: http://example.com/ — single static page. Content: H1 'Example Domain', one paragraph, one outbound link. No nav, no settings, no auth, no state.

nodes.title: Learn more link
nodes.notes: AXLink at ~(320,590) screenshot px. Navigates off-site to https://www.iana.org/domains/example. Dismissed (off-site).

nodes.title: Acrobat extension Updates (separate tab, NOT example.com)
nodes.notes: acrobat.adobe.com/dc-chrome-extension/index.html#/whats-new. Marketing page from the Acrobat Chrome extension. Controls: Open Acrobat extension, Start free trial, Try it now (x5), Learn more (x2), View details, View plans and pricing, Change your preferences — all off-site/commercial/account actions, deliberately not operated.

nodes.title: Chrome address and search bar
nodes.notes: Browser chrome, not the app. To navigate: click, cmd+a, type, verify, return. set_value reverts; type_text appends. Escape (foreground) restores.
